name: lts/php-qa-ci
description: Simple PHP QA pipeline and scripts. Largely just a collection of dependencies with configuration and scripts to run them together

suggest.phploc/phploc: get some stats, not currently compatible with latest symfony
suggest.phpstan/phpstan-deprecation-rules: Checks for deprecated functions and methods
suggest.phpstan/phpstan-mockery: Prevents Mockery from failing on Stan
suggest.sllh/composer-versions-check: To be brought back in when there is a PHP8 version...

known-gaps: toolchain 4.1: the PHPArkitect lane prints no identifier with a violation, runs only over the whole class set, and has no resolver for its bundled tier, so that detector as wrapped fails detector 4.3, 5.2 and 6.1 to 6.3
toolchain 4.1: the packageType, phpstanIgnoreJustification, sensitiveParameterUsage, branchNamePolicy and phpStrictTypes lanes print no identifier with a failure, failing detector 4.3
toolchain 4.1: PHPStan's native identifiers resolve online only and bin/rule-doc does not resolve them, so that detector as wrapped fails detector 6.2 and 6.3
toolchain 4.2: fifteen bundled PHPStan rules resolve to a one-line index row and no page stating the correct construction
toolchain 4.3: a phparkitect-baseline.json is read silently by the PHPArkitect lane, and a PHPStan baseline included from qaConfig/phpstan.neon is not checked by the justification lane
toolchain 5.1: pipeline lanes are listed by bin/rules without an identifier or a documentation route
toolchain 6.2: the justification lane reads qaConfig/phpstan.neon alone and not the files it includes
toolchain 8.1: the release guard requires an index row, not a remediation page, and a lane that prints no identifier is outside it
toolchain 4.1: the same PHPArkitect, lane and PHPStan native-identifier gaps as the artefact, since the project runs the toolchain it ships
toolchain 4.2: the same fifteen bundled rules run on this repository and resolve to no remediation page
toolchain 4.3: the same silent PHPArkitect baseline route is open on this repository
